rules.title: Owner move-in eviction relocation assistance payment
rules.effectiveDateQuote: will go into effect on January 1, 2026
rules.requirement: When an owner evicts a tenant for owner move-in, the owner must pay the tenant relocation assistance. As of January 1, 2026, the standard payment is $19,413 and the additional payment for qualifying households is $6,471.
rules.citation: Berkeley Rent Stabilization and Good Cause for Eviction Ordinance
rules.quotedSpan: The Rent Stabilization and Good Cause for Eviction Ordinance requires owners to pay tenants relocation assistance in the event of an owner move-in eviction.
rules.coverageDescription: All residential rental units in Berkeley subject to the Rent Stabilization and Good Cause for Eviction Ordinance.
warnings: The source does not cite the specific ordinance section number; the citation is the ordinance title only.
The source does not specify which tenants qualify for the additional $6,471 payment.
The source does not indicate the applicability date of the underlying ordinance requiring relocation assistance, only the 2026 adjustment date.

rules.title: Ellis Act eviction relocation assistance payment
rules.effectiveDateQuote: will go into effect on January 1, 2026
rules.requirement: When an owner evicts a tenant under the Ellis Act to remove a property from the rental housing market, the owner must pay the tenant relocation assistance. As of January 1, 2026, the standard payment is $19,413 and the additional payment for qualifying households is $6,471.
rules.quotedSpan: The Ellis Implementation Ordinance requires the same relocation assistance payments for tenants evicted so the owner can remove a property from the rental housing market.
rules.coverageDescription: All residential rental units in Berkeley subject to the Ellis Implementation Ordinance.
warnings: The source does not cite the specific ordinance section number; the citation is the ordinance title only.
